visual.general_description: Color illustration of a head with three burr-hole openings and four circular operative inset views of a branching vessel being exposed and treated.
visual.detailed_description: Color illustration with a thin vertical line dividing a left-facing lateral head view on the left from four circular inset views arranged 2 by 2 on the right. The head is rendered with a semi-transparent scalp showing red branching vessels, a shaded red fan-shaped muscle area over the temple region and three small oval openings outlined in yellow: one upper-left, one upper-right and one circled in the middle of the temple region. A line runs from the circled opening to the right-hand insets. Top-left inset: a spindle-shaped skin opening held by thin metal hooks at the sides, two gray flat blades meeting at the center and red muscle fibers with a small pale bone area visible between them. Top-right inset: a round bone window with a red Y-shaped branching vessel running through it and a speckled pale bone rim at its lower edge. Bottom-left inset: the same window with a gray forceps-like instrument tip touching the vessel, the tip showing an orange tint. Bottom-right inset: the same window with the red vessel shown only as two short red remnants. No printed letters, numbers or other text appear in the image.

visual.detailed_description: Three bone-window CT slices side by side on a black background, each with one short white arrow. Left slice: axial view of the whole skull outline with an oval ring of bone, frontal air-filled spaces at the top and a small bony groove on the right side of the image near the temporal region where the arrow points. Middle slice: coronal view showing an arch of skull vault with scattered bright dots near the upper right and a thin lateral skull wall on the right of the image with a small dark notch where the arrow points; skull base structures are at the bottom. Right slice: a sagittal-appearing view of a rounded skull outline with thick bone, skull base structures at the bottom and a small dark groove on the inner surface on the left of the image where the arrow points. Soft tissue is not displayed (black). No printed text, scale, side markers or identifiers are visible.
